implementation_owners.work: Extend the existing bounded DNS record parser and authority protocol without granting additional scopes to existing handles.
Extend existing DNS jobs and immutable result snapshots; preserve cancellation, timeout, query identity and provider validation.
Provide resolver C interfaces through the scoped native DNS authority and bounded compression-name parsing.
Rebuild and verify a new SDK against reviewed native sources; publication remains manual.

requirements: Do not replace SDK headers with host glibc headers.
Do not implement record lookup as unconditional success or fabricated answers.
Do not bypass native DNS authority by silently choosing an external DNS server.
Existing A/AAAA/PTR scope grants must not acquire new record permissions.
Keep new query types explicitly scoped; reject unknown kinds, malformed replies and oversized results.
further_limitations: Startup-linked DSOs only: GModule runtime loading is unsupported.
GIO native volume monitoring and FD-to-path queries are unsupported; no mount list is fabricated.
Exact pending-byte count for native streams is unavailable; GSocket reports an error.
Optional IP/TCP options are declared for source compatibility but fail explicitly when unsupported by the native provider.
The native GIO TLS provider is implemented as a separate port, but is not yet distributed or executed on mochiOS; WebKit platform integration is pending.
Target execution, network operation and browser integration remain unverified.

native_implementation.scope_policy: ALL_SCOPES remains 7; new record kinds require explicit independent bits
native_implementation.note: Native APIs are included in the manually published shared.3 SDK; library releases remain manual.

private_candidate_verification.note: Private SDK copy with rebuilt native runtime, headers, selected newlib fnmatch and updated driver; published shared.2 remains unchanged

published_sdk_verification.dependency_note: Reused previously target-built ABI-1 dependency prefix; GLib/GIO rebuilt from fixed sources with downloaded shared.3 SDK.

development_codegen.note: Portable upstream Python generators are development data, not target ELF helpers; pkg-config resolves them within the dependency prefix.

native_tls_integration.existing_trust: The native TLS client verifies server certificates using webpki-roots; reuse the existing verification and trust policy.
observed_gaps: GIO wraps an existing GIOStream; the scoped TlsConnect protocol currently creates a transport by hostname and port.
No GIO GTlsBackend adapter or SDK C TLS-session interface is available in shared.3.
Native TLS configuration clears ALPN; the network protocol does not expose ALPN negotiation.
The network protocol returns certificate summaries; GIO certificate objects require a defined mapping of certificate data and verification failures.
The bridge must preserve transport ownership, capability checks, cancellation and nonblocking readiness.
native_tls_integration.scope: No new TLS engine, certificate store, AppCore API or service was introduced by this dependency port.

platform_work: A mochiOS graphics/input/process integration is still required.
Compiling dependency libraries does not constitute a working WebKit port.
webkit.publication: No SDK or library release is created by this porting work.

nghttp2.purpose: HTTP/2 framing and HPACK; TLS and transport are provided separately.

limitations: Target filesystem durability, locking and WAL behavior have not been executed on mochiOS.
Runtime extension loading is disabled; command-line tools are not packaged.

libunistring.purpose: Unicode normalization and case conversion for internationalized hostnames

libidn2.sdk_header_gap: shared.3 exports the native getexecname C ABI but lacks its declaration; the port declares the existing signature locally.

libpsl.purpose: Cookie public-suffix boundaries with full IDNA runtime conversion

libsoup.tls_backend: Startup-linked libgiomochios.so using the native mochiOS verifier; no GnuTLS or alternate trust store.
limitations: Native GIO TLS is cross-linked and host-tested; HTTPS through libsoup and HTTP/2 on mochiOS remain unverified.
The configure tls_check=false setting permits cross-building a component; it does not provide TLS and the catalog remains disabled.
IPv6-only server listeners report unsupported when IPV6_V6ONLY is unavailable.
Brotli, Zstandard, GSSAPI, NTLM, introspection, example applications and runtime tests are not enabled.

host_tls_tests: hostname mismatch rejected even with accept-certificate handler

glib-networking.security: Existing rustls/rustcrypto verifier and production webpki roots; no second TLS engine, trust override, networking capability grant, AppCore API or OS service. Test CA feature is rejected for mochiOS targets.
limitations: TLS 1.3 client only, following the existing native TLS policy.
Canonical ASCII DNS identities only; raw IP and Unicode identities require explicit future support.
No custom trust stores, verification bypass, client certificates, server TLS or session resumption.
Bounded to 16 concurrent native sessions per linked provider; fork children invalidate inherited sessions.
New SDK/archive distribution and mochiOS execution are required before enabling this port.

build_infrastructure.note: Builder image refreshed for dependency-root pkg-config resolution. SDK and library release publication remains manual.
